description: File an e-Transport declaration XML (ANAF's schema v2) with ANAF: a new transport (notificare), its correction (notificare with corectie), a deletion (stergere), a receiver's confirmation (confirmare) or a vehicle change (modifVehicul), whichever the file holds. The XML as xml: { path } for a file, or { content_base64, sha256 } from a script. Goes to ANAF's TEST environment unless test is explicitly false. A money tool (a fiscal declaration): the client asks the user to approve each call, on a line read out of the file (operation, UIT, route, vehicle, goods value in RON, environment). The declarant's code and any UIT must pass their check digits. Returns accepted, the uploadId etransport_status takes and the UIT, or accepted=false with ANAF's reasons; the UIT counts only once etransport_status says ok. The same bytes are not filed in production twice unless refile is true. Needs the ETRANSPORT role on the grant. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

cif.description: The CIF filing it (the declarant's). Defaults to app.json's company_cif.

refile.description: File again a declaration whose exact bytes were already sent to production. Refused without it, so a retry after a lost answer cannot file it twice: check etransport_status or etransport_list first.

test.description: TRUE by default. Pass false to file with ANAF for real.

xml.description: The e-Transport declaration XML (schema v2): { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.

name: etransport_file
title: File an e-Transport declaration
